TranscriptError.description:
Structured error payload for speech recognition failures.

Fields:
    code: Machine-readable error code string (e.g., 'AUDIO_TIMEOUT', 'PROVIDER_ERROR').
    message: Human-readable error description.
    details: Optional dictionary containing additional diagnostic context.
TranscriptError.title: TranscriptError

TranscriptSegment.description:
Atomic unit of transcribed speech representing a phrase, sentence, or utterance.

Fields:
    id: Unique identifier for the segment.
    start_time_ms: Start offset in milliseconds from audio stream onset (unit: ms, ge: 0).
    end_time_ms: End offset in milliseconds from audio stream onset (unit: ms, ge: 0).
    text: Transcribed text content.
    confidence: Normalized confidence score from speech recognizer (range: [0.0, 1.0]).
    is_final: Flag indicating whether this segment is final (immutable) or interim (speculative).
    language: BCP-47 / ISO language code (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'es', 'hi').
    words: Optional list of word-level timings for sub-segment precision.

WordTiming.description:
Word-level timing information for synchronized visual rendering and highlighting.

Fields:
    word: The spoken word token.
    start_time_ms: Start offset from audio onset in milliseconds (>= 0).
    end_time_ms: End offset from audio onset in milliseconds (>= start_time_ms).
    confidence: Word transcription confidence score [0.0, 1.0].

start_time_ms.description: Start offset in milliseconds from audio start
start_time_ms.title: Start Time Ms

end_time_ms.description: End offset in milliseconds from audio start
end_time_ms.title: End Time Ms

WordTiming.title: WordTiming

description:
Immutable snapshot representation of the accumulated transcript state.

Fields:
    session_id: The session identifier.
    final_segments: Ordered list of locked-in TranscriptSegments.
    active_interim: Currently active speculative hypothesis (or None).
    final_text: Concatenated text of all committed final segments.
    full_text: Final text combined with the active interim text.
    total_duration_ms: Total time span from first segment start to latest segment end.
    average_confidence: Weighted average confidence of finalized segments.
    word_count: Total word count in finalized segments.
    speech_active: True if VAD currently detects active speech.
    errors: List of any TranscriptErrors encountered during the session.

total_duration_ms.description: Span from earliest to latest segment in ms
total_duration_ms.title: Total Duration Ms

word_count.description: Count of words in finalized transcript
word_count.title: Word Count
